posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked:
This was once again a fun episode.  Couple of my random thoughts, in no particular order:

  • The subtle sound of a fire that Trevor added when C&A were talking about Adam being on fire was a great little detail.
  • A giant lizard attacks a city, and the Easter egg is that the power plant belongs to the Comteh Energy Corp.  They should have gone with Tokyo Energy Corp or something like that.
  • Loved the character moments this season, especially Tyler Vance’s teaming-up-with-Nightmist-despite-being-afraid moment.
  • When they went over the episode “Revenance”, I originally misheard the title as “Reverance”… in my head-cannon there is now a disparation reality in which Fanatic was armoured in the revenant suit and she took on the hero name “Reverent”.
  • All those glowing red eyes are totally Omnitron.

posts.cooked: Funny they mentioned the “age of the pirates”; there was a cool D&D related short that pointed out that the Age of Sail, the samurai and ninja era of Japan, the Wild West era, and one other popular trochee which I can’t recall were all overlapping within about a ten year period. So there was indeed an era of ninja pirate cowboys plus the other thing; you could make a D&D party with all of them, or you could have a Mary Suish superhero who is all of them at once (a late pirate who’s also an early cowboy etc).
